Walks over to the front counter, the worn paperback is on the glass display case same as it has been for six weeks. *The Shadow of the Wind*. He picks it up, gets the familiar weight, pages dog-eared. Normally hes just put it in the return bin by the register, assumes a confused customer mistaken the drop-box for a library return bin. But tonight it feels different, book is slightly warmer than the cool shop air. He opens it to the bookmarked page. This folded square of lined notebook paper falls out and lands on the counter. Hesitates, unfolds it. Jagged, hurried writing. It says *I know you're reading it. Keep going. Page 204 changes everything.* His heart slams on his ribs, sudden sharp rhythm, and you just have this hum of mixers. Looks around, shop is empty, shadows stretch long on the tiles. No one there.
